classifications.NOT_VERIFIED: No matching local browser receipt for this surface or individual control.
classifications.HOSTED_NOT_VERIFIED: Authenticated hosted role, backend/provider and physical-device acceptance has not been established.

bindingCoverage.scope: Direct source associations can overlap between screens. Remaining inventory entries are shared primitives, handlers, overlays or source outside the listed route bodies; they are retained as source evidence and receive no button PASS.

limitations: The browser harness adapts fonts, gradients, icons and safe areas and uses isolated preview data with network/provider/publication transports blocked.
A PASS route render may display a loading or error state; it does not prove live-data recovery or all conditional states.
Named interaction assertions cannot be matched to every AST binding; no individual source button is promoted to PASS.
Customer preview rendering does not verify vendor/courier/operational-admin routes, account grants, SQL/RLS, devices, payment providers, payouts or push/GPS execution.

The two /tmp receipt summaries are embedded in minimal form with their original file hashes so this document retains their scope and result records. Full rendered DOM text is represented by hashes, not copied as acceptance criteria.
Registered shell routes for unrelated services are included only as navigation registry evidence, not as an audit of those service bodies.
